title: Study Hack #1: self-quiz instead of rereading
cta: Executive Functioning Workbook for Teens · link in bio

copy.caption: Rereading feels productive, but quizzing yourself is usually the stronger study move. Close your notes, write what you remember, then open them and fix the gaps. Those gaps are your study list. Executive Functioning Workbook for Teens (30 short sessions, 6 skills): link in bio.
copy.yt_title: Stop Rereading Your Notes: Try This 3-Step Self-Quiz
copy.pin_title: Self-Quiz Method: A Better Way to Study Than Rereading
copy.pin_desc: Close your notes, write what you remember, then check and fix the gaps. This 3-step self-quiz turns studying into a skill you can build, from the Julia Redmond executive function series for teens. See the Executive Functioning Workbook for Teens: 30 short sessions across six skills.
